claim: AI incident-management platforms use a multi-agent architecture that spawns specialized agents (metrics agent, logs agent, infrastructure agent, code agent) to pursue different root-cause hypotheses in parallel rather than investigating sequentially down a single path.
stance_target: Director/Worker-style parallel-hypothesis multi-agent architectures are a proven pattern for autonomous operational investigation, directly analogous to a 'software factory' department structure
scope_conditions: Resolve.ai vendor description of multi-agent architecture, 2026
quoted_support: Rather than following a single investigation path sequentially, the platform spawns specialized agents that pursue different theories simultaneously. A metrics agent explores dashboards for anomalies, a logs agent iterates on queries to surface relevant events, an infrastructure agent inspects topology changes, and a code agent examines recent changes.

claim: Zscaler (50 million users, 160 data centers, 150,000+ monthly alerts) reported 75% faster root-cause identification and 30% fewer engineers required per incident after deploying Resolve AI, with one DNS resolution issue identified two hours before a human incident bridge was even created.
stance_target: autonomous multi-agent investigation systems materially reduce incident response time and headcount at enterprise scale
scope_conditions: vendor-sourced customer case study (Resolve AI / Zscaler), 2026 -- treat as vendor-reported, not independently audited
quoted_support: Zscaler, managing 50 million users across 160 data centers with 150,000+ alerts monthly, achieved 75% faster root cause identification and reduced the number of engineers required per incident by 30%. Resolve AI helped identified a DNS resolution issue two hours before their human incident bridge was created.

scope_conditions: vendor-sourced customer case study (Resolve AI / Coinbase), 2026 -- vendor-reported, not independently audited
quoted_support: Coinbase, operating thousands of microservices for 120 million users, reduced investigation time by 72% with root cause identification typically under 10 minutes. Resolve AI handles 250+ investigation sessions weekly from over 100 engineers.

quoted_support: DoorDash's ads platform, generating over $1 billion in annualized revenue, saw up to 87% reduction in time to root cause. Investigations that previously required 40 minutes of engineer time completed in under one minute with AI assistance.

claim: AI incident-management platforms incorporate a learning loop where engineer corrections to the agent's reasoning become permanent knowledge that improves future investigations, distinguishing them from static AIOps anomaly-detection tools.
stance_target: continuous operation requires feedback-driven learning mechanisms, not just static rule execution, to improve over time
quoted_support: When an engineer corrects the system's reasoning—"no, check the Redis cluster first, this pattern usually means cache invalidation"—that correction becomes permanent knowledge.
